claims.quote: All the WWOX gene variants in 12 cases were complex heterozygous variants,

claims.object_text: seizure onset 10 days to 6 months (median 1.8 months)
claims.quote: the age of seizure onset ranged from 10 days to 6 months (median 1.8 months).
The common seizure types include focal seizures and epileptic spasms.
All 12 cases showed microcephaly and global developmental delay.
8 of them were diagnosed with infantile epileptic spasm syndrome.

claims.object_text: refractory seizures despite multiple anti-seizure medications
claims.quote: 9 cases still had seizures after multiple anti-seizure medications.

claims.object_text: novel WWOX variants reported in this series
claims.quote: (p.Ala149Thr, p.Arg156Ser, p.R167Tfs*8, p.Leu186Val, c.605+5G>A, p.Trp218*, p.His263Arg, p.Leu275fs*19*1, p.N285Kfs*10, p.Ser304Tyr, p.Met326Arg, loss1 exon2-8) had not been reported previously.
